properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 13 at 6:35AM EDT until September 13 at 9:30AM EDT by NWS Upton NY
properties.description:
FFWOKX

The National Weather Service in Upton has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
South Central Bergen County in northeastern New Jersey...
Essex County in northeastern New Jersey...
Hudson County in northeastern New Jersey...
Eastern Passaic County in northeastern New Jersey...

* Until 930 AM EDT.

* At 635 AM EDT, Doppler radar and automated rain gauges indicated
heavy rain falling across the warned area. Between 0.5 and 1 inch

1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1.5 inches are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by heavy rain.

SOURCE...Radar and automated gauges.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Paterson, Passaic, Wayne, Bloomfield, Orange, Paramus, Lyndhurst,
Rutherford, Caldwell, Kearny, Hawthorne, Fairfield, Clifton, East
Orange, West Orange, Montclair, Belleville, Fair Lawn, Garfield and

properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.

areas, highways, streets and underpasses as well as other drainage
areas and low lying spots.

properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued September 12 at 9:51AM PDT until September 14 at 5:00PM PDT by NWS Sacramento CA
properties.description:
...RED FLAG WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL 5 PM PDT MONDAY DUE TO WIND
AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR A PORTION OF NORTHERN CALIFORNIA...

* AFFECTED AREA...Portions of the Sacramento Valley and adjacent
foothills.

* TIMING...Until 5 PM PDT Monday.

* WINDS...Gusts 20 to 35 mph. South to southwest winds through
Saturday afternoon. Winds shift out of the north during the day on
Sunday, becoming gusty by the evening and through Monday morning.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Relative Humidity between 10 to 25 percent.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will spread rapidly. Outdoor
burning is not recommended.
properties.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions are
either occurring now, or will shortly. A combination of strong winds,
low relative humidity, and warm temperatures can contribute to
extreme fire behavior.

NWSheadline: RED FLAG WARNING NOW IN EFFECT UNTIL 5 PM PDT MONDAY

properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued September 12 at 9:15AM MDT until September 13 at 9:00PM MDT by NWS Missoula MT
properties.description:
...RED FLAG WARNING IN EFFECT FROM NOON TO 9 PM MDT SUNDAY DUE TO
WIND AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR EAST BEAVERHEAD...

The National Weather Service in Missoula MT has issued a Red Flag
Warning in effect from noon to 9 PM MDT Sunday.

* AFFECTED AREA...Fire Weather Zone 111.

* TIMING...From noon to 9 PM MDT Sunday.

* WINDS...Southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Relative Humidity between 15 to 25 percent.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will spread rapidly. Outdoor
burning is not recommended.
properties.instruction:
Please advise the appropriate officials or fire crews in the field of
this Red Flag Warning.

Make and maintain your go kit. Is it ready to go? Are there any
materials you need to refresh? Visit ready.gov/kit.

A Red Flag Warning is issued when we identify weather conditions that
promote rapid spread of fire which may become life-threatening. This
does not mean there is a fire. These conditions are either occurring
now or will begin soon. It is important to have multiple ways to
receive information from authorities.

NWSheadline: RED FLAG WARNING IN EFFECT FROM NOON TO 9 PM MDT SUNDAY
